liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodeloo** (1 review): The Half-Step into Franklin's opener is hot [12]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Reviewer was carried away by Tennessee Jed, though the tape version is incomplete [11]
- **The Music Never Stopped** (1 review): Reviewer calls The Music Never Stopped a searing, shredding standout version [18]
- **Shakedown Street** (1 review): Shakedown emerged from Space and lived up to its reputation [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-11-23.fob.sonyECM250.walker.scotton.miller.96031.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 169 min; rated 4.73/5 by 11 [1]
- **gd78-11-23.sbd.cotsman.19155.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 157 min; rated 4.36/5 by 11 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard exists, implying it is a treat, but gives no specific sound detail; The tape is of iffy quality, jumping between soundboard and a poor audience source; Soundboard mixes board and audience sources, a flaw; the second-set audience source is much better than the first-set one [9][10][13][18]
- **gd78-11-23.aud.wiley.11668.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 3.17/5 by 6 [4]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the audience tape a great one of this show; Not the best recording, but decent enough to be worth a listen; Audience tape isn't great but is listenable once ears adjust [8][11][12]
- **gd1978-11-23.167731.S2.ShureSM57.Sublette.Noel.Goldey.t-flac2496**: source not stated; 11 songs; 94 min [6]

## Around the show

- The show fell on Thanksgiving, which the reviewer cites as a reason to attend a Dead show [7]
- Reviewer notes any seat in the Capital Centre is far from the stage [13]
- Jerry felt under the weather but it didn't show; reviewer was among traveling Deadheads in the crowd [16]
- Like most late-1978 shows, Keith is barely audible, letting Bobby's comping lines come forward [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-11-23.fob.sonyECM250.walker.scotton.miller.96031.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: (FOB) Sony ECM250 -> Cassette Master (Maxell UD-XLII) [1]. Also: Chain: unknown mics to cassette master to DAT to CD, with pitch correction applied; Tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker; patches supply parts of Playing In The Band and Around And Around [1]
- **gd78-11-23.sbd.cotsman.19155.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Soundboard release is a composite compiled from earlier soundboard and audience sources [3]
- **gd78-11-23.aud.wiley.11668.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [4]
- **gd1978-11-23.167731.S2.ShureSM57.Sublette.Noel.Goldey.t-flac2496**: taped by Kathy Sublette; transferred by DSF Transfer by Mark Goldey Edited & Mastered by Joe Noel April 30, 2024; source: Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158 (Dolby ??) > Master Cassettes [6]. Also: Her first-set recording is missing; Joani Walker supplied the patch source [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Peter Bickmore: [Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1978-11-23](https://edeadshop.com/blogs/crew-tunes/grateful-dead-live-at-capital-centre-on-1978-11-23) [20]
